note.zh-Hant: Maginot 帶外側：USMA Map 14 只畫出 Maginot 要塞帶，沒有標示要塞帶與國界（或萊茵河）之間的狹長地帶由誰控制；以戰線與要塞帶交會點的經線為西界，不推測。
note.en: Beyond the Maginot belt: USMA Map 14 shows the Maginot belt but not who held the strip between it and the border/Rhine; bounded on the west by the meridian of the junction of the front and the belt.
